recommendation_summary: The reply recommends building one shared save path this week. That path locks the item, checks for overlapping dates and then writes or refuses, all in one step, and direct edits to the grid are closed off. When two agents clash, the second gets a clear refusal. The user should also decide whether the return day counts as booked. The spreadsheet can stay as a live view or export, and its formatting can flag old bad rows during cleanup. Colours and reminders are rejected as the safeguard. What's missing: the reply never names what storage or system backs the save path, and it has none of the four required labelled lines.
note: The reply makes a strong LARGER recommendation with an atomic check and write and explicit handling of two simultaneous saves, but all four required labels are missing, so every record predicate is false.
